text: dsh-session-dashboard 是面向 DSH Web 界面的会话状态侧栏卡片插件，通过客户端模块在侧栏底部和设置页注册界面。它汇总会话标题、活动时间、运行状态、待处理交互与未读完成状态，提供全部、需要你、运行中和已完成筛选，并显示计数。用户可从卡片打开会话或新建会话，也能调整显示行数、语言并折叠卡片。插件读取 DSH 客户端会话与工作区数据，将卡片偏好保存在浏览器本地；代码没有配置 API 密钥或外部服务调用。适合希望在侧栏快速查看并切换近期会话的 DSH Web 用户。

dsh-session-dashboard adds a status card to the DSH Web sidebar. It shows session activity, running work, and unread completions, with filters and counts. Users can open or start sessions, choose a language, set visible rows, and collapse the card. Preferences stay in browser storage.
想在 DSH 侧栏直接看哪些会话正在运行或等我处理。
我想从一个固定的侧栏卡片筛选并打开最近的会话。
Show me session status and pending requests in the DSH sidebar.
dsh-session-dashboard 的功能「会话状态筛选」：侧栏卡片列出会话状态与活动信息，并按全部、需要你、运行中或已完成筛选，同时显示各状态计数。
dsh-session-dashboard 的功能「会话快捷切换」：点击卡片中的会话行可打开该会话，点击新建按钮可启动新会话；折叠侧栏时也提供带状态提示的入口。

dsh-session-dashboard README · dsh-session-dashboard：A DeepSeek Harness Web GUI plugin: an **always-visible session status card in the left sidebar** (above Settings), so recent session activity is visible without opening a page.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

dsh-session-dashboard README · Features：- Persistent card in the left sidebar; when the sidebar collapses to its 56px rail it becomes an icon button with a "Needs you" badge
- One row per session: status glyph, title, current activity (Waiting for approval / Working / Completed unread / Idle) and relative time
- Filters All / Needs you / Running / Done with live counts; the card keeps the same height when switching filters
- Click a row to open that session; `+` starts a new session
- The currently open session has a tinted background and bold title; the highlight follows session navigation
- Click the card header (disclosure caret) to collapse or expand it; the collapsed header keeps the current status counts, and the state is remembered in this browser
- 5 rows by default, expandable to 10
- Settings → Sessions card section: card language (English / 中文) and default row count
- Needs-you, running and unread-completed sessions are listed first; running rows have a sweep animation

dsh-session-dashboard README · Features：> Session titles in the screenshot are sample data.

Verified on DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` (Web profile) and `0.2.1-rc.3` (Desktop profile): installed with the official `dsh plugin` command, `--dump-config` shows the `# == dsh-session-dashboard` layer, client-modules serves the bundle, card placement/filters/navigation/new-session/rail badge all work, and the console reports no plugin errors.

dsh-session-dashboard README · Official plugin form：| Official requirement | This package |
|---|---|
| `dsh.bundle.patch` points at the config layer | `./cordis.patch.yml` inserts the package into the Loader by name |
| `dsh.client.platform: "web"` + `exports["./client"]` | points at `client/client.js` (prebuilt `__ModuleLoader__` factory) |
| `engines.dsh` compatibility range | `>=0.2.0 <0.3.0` (passes on 0.2.1-rc.2 / rc.3) |
| Installed into the profile's `bundles` list | `dsh plugin add` appends it automatically |
| Prebuilt artifact, no install-time build | plain JS, no `prepare`/build script, so git/tarball/npm installs need no build approval |
| `license`, `icon`, `files` | MIT, `icon.svg`, complete publish file list |
dsh-session-dashboard README · Official plugin form：Official docs: [Package and install a plugin](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/en/develop/basic/publish.md).

dsh-session-dashboard README · Install：The plugin is browser-only: no Host service, no configuration, no background work. Install and uninstall go through the official `dsh plugin` command (pnpm + profile manifest); no hand-edited profile or node_modules.

dsh-session-dashboard README · 1. Build the release artifact：Run inside the plugin directory:

```powershell
pnpm pack --pack-destination <output dir>

dsh-session-dashboard README · 2. Desktop profile：The `desktop` profile belongs to the Electron app and the global npm CLI refuses to manage it; use the command runtime bundled with the desktop app:

```powershell
$dsh = "<DeepSeek Harness install dir>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd"
& $dsh plugin --profile desktop add <output dir>\dsh-session-dashboard-<version>.tgz
& $dsh plugin --profile desktop --dump-config   # optional: should show "# == dsh-session-dashboard"
```

dsh-session-dashboard README · 2. Desktop profile：Installation records the artifact under the profile's `dependencies` (`file:...tgz`) and appends the bundle to `dsh.profile.bundles`; pnpm materializes it into `node_modules`. **Keep the tarball**: the profile dependency points at it, and moving or deleting it requires another `add`.

Upgrade: bump `version` → `pnpm pack` again → run `add` with the new tarball. Uninstall:

```powershell
& $dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-session-dashboard
```
dsh-session-dashboard README · 2. Desktop profile：Reload the desktop window (`Ctrl+R`) or restart the app; a live patch reload only needs a page refresh.

dsh-session-dashboard README · 3. Web profile：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add <plugin dir>
dsh --profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-session-dashboard
```

`dsh plugin` resolves the local package as a pnpm `link:` dependency and appends the bundle automatically; restart `dsh web` (or refresh the page) to apply.

dsh-session-dashboard README · Data sources：The card requests nothing from the Host and stores no session state. It occupies the root-scoped sidebar footer seat and reads the standard seats the slot system provides to every root slot:

dsh-session-dashboard README · Data sources：| Seat / data | Used for |
|---|---|
| `useSessions` | session catalog, `displayTitle`, `updatedAt`, `blank`/`origin`, `projectionsBySession` |
| `useSessionStatus` | `running`, `pendingInteraction` (`approval` / `plan-review` / `question`), `completionUnread` |
| `useWorkspaces` | `archivedSessionIds` (archived sessions are hidden by default) |
| `projectionsBySession[*].values` | `todos` (current todo), `turnOutline` (current prompt and turn count), `sessionStats` |

dsh-session-dashboard README · Data sources：Opening a session uses `ctx.uiWorkspace.openSession(id)`, starting one uses `ctx.uiWorkspace.startSession()`, and the collapsed-rail icon uses `ctx.layout.toggleSidebar()`.

dsh-session-dashboard README · Structure：```
package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client (platform: web) + engines.dsh
cordis.patch.yml      # inserts this package as a Loader entry in the profile
lib/index.js          # empty Host-half plugin (keeps a Loader fiber so client-modules serves the browser half)
client/client.js      # the whole UI: __ModuleLoader__ factory + React card + themed CSS

dsh-session-dashboard README · Structure：`client/client.js` is a hand-written CJS-in-loader factory (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`) and **needs no build**: edit it and refresh. Its only runtime dependency is `react` from the platform baseline; styling uses the host's `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens, so light and dark themes both work.

Known limitations: [docs/limitations.md](docs/limitations.md).
